svg.title: Figure 4 · Trace depth per safety goal
svg.desc: For each safety goal: the derived and refined requirement counts, the share allocated to model elements and the share named by a test-specification case. Over all goals 313 of 367 requirements are allocated, 270 named and 36 linked to an existing test; none is verified by a recorded passed test.
svg.text: Figure 4 · Trace depth per safety goal
How far each goal's chain reaches today, over the requirements it derives (FSR, TSR, SWSR, HWSR). No chain reaches a recorded result.
count of derived items (proposed, not approved)
“Named”: a test-specification case cites the ID. “Linked”: links/verification.yaml links an existing test to it (WP-W-06 §4.1, §4.9). Both are specified links, not a passed test (K7).
Allocated: the requirement's allocated_to names elements of the SysML model (check M8). A requirement under several goals counts in each row.
